coach_says: Garmin flags UNPRODUCTIVE with TSB at -55.5, anaerobic and low-aerobic loads already well above target — this is a clear signal to cut volume and intensity hard this week. The only quality session is Tuesday's non-negotiable MTB group ride; everything else is deliberately easy, short, or restorative to restore training stress balance. Long ride volume is shifted to Saturday's good weather window at an easy Zone 2 pace, not as an intensity session.

days.details: 40 min gentle mobility and recovery flow: focus on hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine, and breathing. No cycling today given severe accumulated fatigue (TSB -55.5, Garmin UNPRODUCTIVE). Objective: parasympathetic recovery ahead of Tuesday's committed hard ride.

days.session: AM easy spin + PM committed hard MTB group ride
days.details: AM (before work): 30 min Zone 1 easy spin, legs-only shake-out, no intensity. PM (committed, non-negotiable): Hard MTB group ride ~60 min, high effort technical terrain, Zone 4-5 surges. This is the single quality/hard session for the week — proceed regardless of fatigue per commitment, but AM kept deliberately minimal to protect recovery.
Complete rest — mandatory recovery from Tuesday's hard double session per constraint (never hard/moderate Wednesday). Prioritise sleep, hydration, and nutrition. No structured training.

Workout A (Deload — reduced load, 3+ reps in reserve on all lifts):
Warm-up: 5-10 min easy bike + dynamic mobility

Romanian Deadlift 3x6-8 (light-moderate load)
Bulgarian Split Squat 2x8-10
Chest Supported Row 3x8-12
Dumbbell Bench Press 3x8-12
Copenhagen Plank 2x15-20 sec
Dead Bug 2x8 each side

Main lifts: 2 min rest
Accessories: 60 sec rest

Objective: maintain strength stimulus and movement quality without adding systemic fatigue.

Warmup: 200m easy freestyle
Main: 4x150m (first 50m easy / next 100m moderate), 20 sec rest
Cooldown: 100m easy
Total: ~1000m
Objective: low-impact aerobic recovery; poor weather (drizzle, 41% rain) and high fatigue mean no ride today.

150 min | Objective: Aerobic endurance (Zone 2 only)
20 min Zone 1-2 warm-up
100 min steady Zone 2, conversational pace, no intervals or surges
30 min Zone 1 cool-down
Ideal weather window — volume prioritised over intensity given current fatigue status; keep power/HR strictly capped in Zone 2.
60 min easy MTB, Zone 1-2 only, flowy/non-technical trails, no hard efforts. Purely recreational and restorative to close the week; avoid any climbing repeats or hard surges.
